name: CircuitHub
long_description: CircuitHub offers on-demand electronics manufacturing powered by our factory-scale robotics platform, The Grid. This platform delivers a 10x improvement in the speed and cost of small-batch electronics production. Leading customers like Tesla, NASA, and Zipline rely on CircuitHub to cut their time to market in half.
